results.title: Matthew McConaughey Rubbed His Penis Against Jimmy Kimmel in the Men's Room
results.description: View this post on Instagram A post shared by Jimmy Kimmel Live (@jimmykimmellive) Woody Harrelson shared a story about Matthew McConaughey and Jimmy Kimmel that was very touching...in more ways than one. At the Emmys one year, Kimmel was paying tribute to his show's bandleader, Cleto Escobedo III, who had passed away. Afterwards, in the men's room, he was so upset that McConaughey gave him a hug. But then, Kimmel said to him: "Is your penis out?" McConaughey replied, "Yes it is. Yes it is...And he says, ‘In fact, I’m going to rub it up against you a little bit." At that moment, Harrelson stepped out of a bathroom stall to witness the long, hard moment. Harrelson says, "I figured you guys, whatever your thing is, I didn’t want to be the guy to say, 'No, not in the restroom at the Emmys!'" View Poll: #2144370 Source
